narrative_analyst.agent_description: Analyzes game lore, quest objectives, and physical game events to resolve discrepancies and identify true progression leads.
narrative_analyst.agent_system_prompt: You are a specialized narrative and progression analyst for Pokémon Sors. Your job is to strictly distinguish empirical game observations from unverified assumptions, evaluate story flags, and determine concrete next physical steps.
narrative_analyst.agent_input_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"topic":{"type":"string","description":"The storyline event, NPC, or physical mystery to analyze."},"known_facts":{"type":"string","description":"Verified physical game observations and coordinates."}},"required":["topic","known_facts"]}
narrative_analyst.agent_output_schema: {"type":"object","properties":{"analysis":{"type":"string","description":"Detailed reasoning separating facts from assumptions."},"recommended_actions":{"type":"string","description":"Concrete physical actions or locations to inspect in-game."}},"required":["analysis","recommended_actions"]}
